title: Andrew Ryan's last choice in BioShock

tags: a man chooses a slave obeys

scenes.text: Andrew Ryan handed his killer the golf club himself.
A New Year's Eve riot in 1958 had sparked a civil war, and Ryan had set the city to self-destruct.
When Jack reached his office in Hephaestus, Ryan was practicing his golf swing.
He knew exactly who Jack was, and proved it with orders. Sit. Stand. Run. Stop.
A man chooses, he said. A slave obeys.
Then he gave his son the club and told him to finish it.
Fans believe Ryan picked that death to show he still owned his fate, even if Jack didn't own his.
